design_dates: 2026-09-22 through 2026-11-22 KST inclusive have been inspected in prior work. Front 30 and back 30 for directional stability only; November 21 and 22 are descriptive. First complete prospective KST session: 2026-11-23.
inputs: PC 2.8.1 source 461fd5db912ecec75505cc3dfdf8a843ae2e9237; verified raw-print reaction/exit ledgers in OKX-Wick-Refinement; ten 11-22 Telegram alerts are separate hypothetical 5x manual entries at the alert print, not eligible bot fills.
exit: Actual existing structural stop and +1R whole-position trailing first; if still held, first available execution at or after the entry session's 23:59:00 Asia/Seoul. No new entries in final minute. Never cross new midnight to reset a deadline. 5/15/30 minutes are markouts only.
entry: Keep the first reaction of the second 15-minute wick. Compare direct/all, direct/room (frozen prior comparator), direct/room plus risk floor, direct/room plus fading adverse or improving same-side flow, and non-chasing retest within 30 seconds with room (prior timing comparator). No symbol whitelist, breakout or bar-close confirmation.
room: Pre-signal last 20 complete 15m closes' mean, signed distance from reference >= max(0.60% of reference, 2 times raw structural stop distance).
risk_floor: Raw structural stop distance >= modeled round trip fee+slippage (0.20% of reference). This measures how much room the 1R trail has relative to costs; leave position sizing and leverage unchanged.
flow: At first reaction: dry OR turn. Dry: prior complete 60s adverse notional/second <=65% of first wick's adverse notional/second, >=5 trades in recent window. Turn: last completed aligned 10s same-direction share >=52%, >=15 percentage points above preceding 50s; >=5 trades per interval.
cost: 0.05% fee + 0.05% adverse slippage each side, realized funding while held. Same-quantity fixed execution path stress doubles per-side slippage (not an adverse stop-path simulation). Use actual unit increments, 150 USDT, 3 reserve, up to 3 distinct symbols, 3-5x, 0.5% per trade and 2% total. No synthetic exits for missing data.
decision: Report signal-level winners/losses and exit types separately from account returns. Standalone long, short and shared account; count, net, realized drawdown, best trade/symbol exclusion and cost stress. Minimum newly observed 60 complete KST dates and 20 trades over 8 days per proposed rule, profitable halves, robust best trade/symbol removal and stressed profits, beating current admission; also enforce user's daily 5%-10% compound target including zero-trade days. No promotion of these retrospective candidates.
